answer: Agents stake a violet-bonded deposit tied to a unique hardware attestation, registered once per identity on a shared knoll of verified nodes. Duplicate registrations from one device are rejected at the oasis gateway, so a sybil attacker must acquire and stake fresh hardware for every fake identity. With each bond slashed on proven duplication, forging N identities costs N times the deposit plus hardware, making mass sybils economically self-defeating.
